label: MEXC (spot)
terms_note: Public market-data endpoints only (no key). Mapped from MEXC's own Postman collection (github.com/mexcdevelop/mexc-api-postman, 'MEXC V3', collection v2.1; base URL from its 'V3 MEXC GLOBAL' environment: https://api.mexc.com) and the HTML docs. The collection's kline example uses interval=1m and calls the values only 'ENUM: Kline interval'; live 2026-10-01 the hour interval is '60m' ('1h' answers 400 {"msg":"Invalid interval.","code":-1121}). An unknown symbol answers 400 {"msg":"invalid symbol","code":-1121}. exchangeInfo lists about 1,900 symbols.

list_markets.note: Every spot symbol (BTCUSDT style) with base/quote; paged locally; query matches symbol, assets or the coin's full name.

not_offered.me: Account endpoints need X-MEXC-APIKEY and an HMAC-SHA256 signature over the query (the collection's {{signature}}/{{timestamp}}); public-data entry only.
not_offered.get_balances: GET /api/v3/account is signed; public-data entry only.
not_offered.list_orders: GET /api/v3/openOrders is signed; public-data entry only.
not_offered.place_order: POST /api/v3/order is signed and spends money; not mapped.

live_check.notes: all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
